correctness.rationale: The Fourier-state generator and its symmetric resolvent give an exact rational time correlation. For D>0, Parseval summability plus the translational diffusion spectral gap allow the covariance integral and locally uniform complex continuation. The Stieltjes poles are distinct for D>0, v>0; their residues recover each power. Subtraction of N+1 readings eliminates D0 and gives an invertible Cauchy matrix. An N-reading nullspace perturbation inside a positive parameter region proves minimality. The attached symbolic verifier and numerical quadratures check essential finite-dimensional identities without claiming to prove infinite statements.

originality.rationale: The forward Green--Kubo-resolvent method is known. The assessed extension identifies every harmonic power from a tumbling-rate transport observable, proves a sharp N+1 measurement threshold with unknown thermal baseline, and exhibits exact propulsion/noise identifiability boundaries. The motivating interacting-particle article analyzes effective diffusion but does not state this inverse result. residual_risks: Abstract inverse-Stieltjes or Cauchy-matrix identifiability literature may subsume the rational reconstruction; no global novelty guarantee.

value.rationale: Reconstructing unknown periodic-force harmonic power from diffusion-versus-tumbling measurements is a natural inverse transport question. The exact sharp number of measurements, infinite-band uniqueness, non-identifiability when propulsion or driver Brownian noise vanishes, and monotone-response consistency law give precise experiment-design and mechanistic discriminants rather than merely an isolated forward diffusivity formula. The conclusion is confined to a physically defined exogenous driver and does not assert experimental noise robustness.
